task.subject: Fix callable ``flag_value`` being instantiated when used as a default

winning_diff:
--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -2655,7 +2655,13 @@ class Option(Parameter):
         # https://github.com/pallets/click/issues/3024#issuecomment-3146199461
         # https://github.com/pallets/click/pull/3030/commits/06847da
         if self.default is True and self.flag_value is not UNSET:
             self.default = self.flag_value
+            # The default was aligned with the flag value. The flag value can
+            # be an arbitrary object, such as a class, which is itself
+            # callable. Remember the alignment so that ``get_default`` does
+            # not invoke the default as if it were a callable default.
+            self._default_is_flag_value = True
+        else:
+            self._default_is_flag_value = False
 
         # Set the default flag_value if it is not set.
         if self.flag_value is UNSET:
@@ -2815,6 +2821,21 @@ class Option(Parameter):
 
         return name, opts, secondary_opts
 
+    def get_default(
+        self, ctx: Context, call: bool = True
+    ) -> t.Any | t.Callable[[], t.Any] | None:
+        value = super().get_default(ctx, call=False)
+
+        if call and callable(value):
+            # A default that was aligned with the flag value is returned
+            # as-is: the flag value may itself be callable (e.g. a class)
+            # without being a lazy default.
+            if self._default_is_flag_value and value is self.default:
+                return value
+            return value()
+
+        return value
+
     def add_to_parser(self, parser: _OptionParser, ctx: Context) -> None:
         if self.multiple:
             action = "append"
